description: This file defines the 'License' class within the OrangeHRM core reporting module. The class extends a base display field class and specifies methods for getting DTO class info, entity aliases, and database fields related to license information in the HR system.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a display field for license information within the HRM reporting framework, providing metadata such as DTO class, entity aliases, and related database fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, specifically the License DTO class.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in database queries, here mapping 'license' as the alias.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that are relevant to this display field, here 'employee.empNumber'.
